req.title: 404 on unknown task id
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 and detail 'Task not found' when the id does not exist.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 404 with a specific detail message when GET /tasks/{task_id} is called with a non-existent ID. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — a known-good ID from pre-loaded data returns 200; (2) negative EP — a clearly non-existent ID returns 404 with exact detail text; (3) BVA boundary — ID just above the highest seeded row (21) is non-existent; (4) BVA boundary — ID 0 (below minimum valid PK) returns 404; (5) NEG — negative integer ID returns 404. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact response body fields to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and string-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_get_existing_task_returns_200
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 20 seed rows
Task with id=1 exists with title='Read chapter 5'
expected: Response JSON contains id=1 and title='Read chapter 5' and completed=true
trace: R-TASK-009 — positive path: existing task must NOT return 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine, SessionLocal
from app import models
from datetime import datetime

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
task = models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', description='Signal pulse ember', completed=True,
    created_at=datetime(2025, 6, 1, 5, 4, 17))
db.add(task)
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_existing_task_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/tasks/1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 1
    assert body['title'] == 'Read chapter 5'
    assert body['completed'] == True
